asked.item: Need to pay HeyGen for this to work

verdict.reason: The FAQ states that the Free API plan won't work and that HeyGen's $99/mo API plan is required.

steps.text: "You're On Heygen Free Plan" is one of the most common reasons the CREATE HEYGEN AVATAR VIDEO step fails.
HeyGen API requires you to pay for its $99/mo API plan, and the Free API plan won't work.
